answer_1.quote: Our approach leverages a generative Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to mine new potential attributes from both images and texts... Attribute Generation Tuning Data (AGTD) aids MLLMs in accurately extracting attribute-value pairs from multimodal information.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate performance using two metrics: 1) Precision, the ratio of true positives to total positive predictions, and 2) Recall, the proportion of true positives among all actual positives. We report Exact Match and Similar Match as in previous work.
